item.title: Trump AI Preemption: Kill State Laws?
item.description:
President Trump's March 2026 AI framework demands federal preemption of state laws like Colorado's. Will it unify U.S. AI policy and slash compliance costs—or trigger a constitutional battle that fragments American AI leadership? Eric and Bella debate whether the White House blueprint can actually override states already enforcing their own rules.
Timestamps: 00:00 — Cold Open 02:00 — Topic Frame 03:00 — Segment 1 07:00 — Segment 2 17:00 — Segment 3 21:00 — Recap
Sources cited in this episode: • White House National Policy Framework for Artificial Intelligence — March 20, 2026 — called for broa • Senator Marsha Blackburn TRUMP AMERICA AI Act discussion draft — 291 pages, released March 2026 • Trump Executive Order 'Ensuring a National Policy Framework for Artificial Intelligence' — December • NetChoice Director Patrick Hedger statement — March 20, 2026 — praised Framework as 'light-touch' ap • ARI President Brad Carson criticism — March 2026 — called Framework 'Mad Max for AI industry'

item.title: GPT-5: End of Coding Jobs?
item.description:
GPT-5 launched in August 2025 with state-of-the-art coding abilities. Eight months later, developers are still employed. Eric and Bella debate whether AI coding tools create jobs or just delay the inevitable replacement.
